name: Vibration motor
description: aw8624 haptic driver firmware from the curtana ROM; the kernel also exposes the motor as /sys/class/leds/vibrator, which the vibrator HDI uses for timed vibrations. curtana units have either an aw8624 (supported) or a TI drv2624 motor; the drv2624 driver only offers /sys/class/timed_output/vibrator, so on those units vibration does not work yet.
